theme: SIP fundamentals: power of compounding, rupee cost averaging
headline: SIP: Building Wealth Through Consistency
body: Regular contributions over time benefit from compounding growth and reduce timing risks through rupee cost averaging.
caption: When you invest fixed amounts regularly, you buy more units when prices are lower and fewer when prices are high. This disciplined approach smooths out market volatility over the long term. #SIPFundamentals #CompoundingPower #RupeeCostAveraging #LongTermWealth #SmartInvesting
